title: ATS V&V Engineer
desc:
Req ID: 531082
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
More than a job: a mission
We're looking for a dedicated ATS V&V Engineer to join our team in Istanbul. You'll work alongside people who show up with ownership, passion, and dedication.
Your role, your impact
Execute verification and validation activities for ATS, SCADA, and security subsystems.
Develop and review test specifications, procedures, and reports to ensure compliance with system requirements.
Configure test bench environments and manage defect tracking through change requests.
Execute both automatic and manual tests using simulators, analyze results, and support problem resolution.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams globally to uphold performance and safety standards.
You'll work with sharp, committed teams solving complex challenges that shape the future of mobility. As an ATS V&V Engineer , your expertise ensures systems that guarantee reliable rail operations.
What you bring
Degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Control and Automation Engineering.
Fundamental programming knowledge, including Python and SQL.
Experience with Linux and Windows operating systems.
Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving capabilities.
Fluency in English and excellent teamwork and communication skills.
How success is measured
Delivery of high-quality verification and validation outputs within project timelines.
Effective defect management and proactive issue resolution.
Collaboration and knowledge sharing across multidisciplinary and global teams.
Alstom, a great place to grow
Be part of a global organization driving safer and more reliable mobility systems.
Contribute to innovative ATS solutions transforming rail operations in Istanbul.
Grow your career in a learning-focused environment that supports both technical and leadership development.
You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
Important to note
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.
